usage_note: Within cap. No story text or data files touched (tools/build_story.py remains the only writer of generated story data).
open_questions: LOSS is recorded as side LOSS / END_LOSS (per launch prompt; the brief said not to). Keep it, or drop it?
Tier is stored as empty string: no tier is known at _finish. Is a tier wanted in the record?
Stats show no 'wins' key: 'runs' counts all recorded runs and choices.LOSS separates losses. OK?
handoff: Each run is recorded once in user://stats.json from main._finish (the run_recorded flag guards it; _finish clears the save, so a reload cannot recount). Format: schema_version, runs, choices {RELEASE, CORP, LOSS}, endings {id: count}, last {side, ending, tier, cycle, cash}. Atomic write via stats.json.tmp then rename; unreadable file moves to stats.bad.json. Debug menu (debug builds only) has a 'Force goal at cycle end' toggle and shows the stats file path. Headless: forced win, RELEASE then a second run CORP gave counts 1/1 and accumulated across instances; corrupt file moved to bad. Project loads with no script errors.

details.try: Run, open debug menu, toggle Force goal, press Advance to next cycle, pick a side; open the path shown in the menu.
